sections.text:
-During Element Battles when this Unison effect is used, the values of the Dark and Time element weakening effects on monsters are increased by 10%.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 400. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Removes Rejection from all allies.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (2 times).
-Target: All allies including the Rear Guard. Recovers 30 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 60 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Increases the Ability Power of Lancer/Ninja's physical/magic Abilities by 20 when equipped in the Main Slot.
